summary: At the saved v6 baseline, the Rogue presses C at step 2. C cmd.c binds C to do_name.c:docallcmd(), which displays “What do you want to name?”. JS had both the binding and menu handler but lacked command admission and the direct rhack() dispatch; admission alone would have fallen through to a later refusal. The source-aligned C13 fix supplies both paths, and the current saved evaluation matches this whole case.

source.branch: The parsed key is C with no count or movement prefix; cmd.c’s call command row invokes do_name.c:docallcmd(), which builds the naming menu and returns ECMD_OK after selection or dismissal.
callers: cmd.c parse() returns C to rhack(), which resolves the call row and invokes do_name.c:docallcmd().

At the baseline, js/cmd.js parsed C and resolved commandForKey() to call, but admitParsedCommand() rejected it. The existing executeCommandHandler() docallcmd arm served typed extended commands only; direct C and Meta-N also needed a rhack() branch. js/do_name.js:docallcmd() owns the menu.
dependencies: The same source command has the extended name alias; keep byte binding, repeated-command guard, and handler admission consistent. Later inventory selection and do_name.c:docall() must be evaluated after the first command boundary is opened.

evidence: Saved v6 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260926071400-v6.json at 3b1e337022043d314860fa14efc520d2600bf194 reports 2/14 matching screens, all 2319/2319 RNG calls through the stop, and first mismatch step 2: unsupported hero command at the repeated-command admission boundary.

The independent C recording challenges/cases/v6/v6-add6-rogue-call-potion-type.session.json has step 2 key C, zero RNG calls, and the “What do you want to name?” menu. Step 3 selects o and reaches the inventory-type call prompt.

Upstream cmd.c command table binds C to do_name.c:docallcmd(); cmd.c:rhack invokes a recognized handler. Upstream do_name.c:docallcmd() constructs the same menu and selects its o arm for an inventory type.

js/extcmdlist_data.js binds C and Meta-N to call/name, but baseline js/cmd.js omitted both from ADMITTED_COMMANDS and lacked a direct rhack() dispatch. Its executeCommandHandler() docallcmd arm served only the extended-command route. C13 adds both missing source paths and preserves the ECMD_OK command reset; a direct-key menu test covers C, Meta-n, and Meta-N.
